source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the repeated widow term and the text's category distinction.
key_decisions.before: Honor widows who are truly widows.
key_decisions.after: Honor widows who are truly widows.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Honor widows who are truly widows.

key_decisions.before: But the one who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.
key_decisions.after: But the widow who lives for self-indulgence is dead even while alive.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains widening family duty and the strong comparison.
key_decisions.before: But if anyone does not provide for their own, especially members of their household, they have denied the faith and are worse than an unbeliever.
key_decisions.after: But if anyone does not provide for their own, and especially for members of the household, that person has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But if anyone does not provide for his own, and especially for members of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps exact age and female marital idiom.
key_decisions.before: Let a widow be enrolled only if she is at least sixty years old, faithful to one husband,
key_decisions.after: A widow is to be enrolled only if she is at least sixty years old and has been a one-man woman,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let a widow be enrolled if she is not less than sixty years of age, having been the wife of one husband,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps administrative refusal and the text's characterization of desire.
key_decisions.before: But refuse to enroll younger widows, because when their desires draw them away from Christ, they want to marry,
key_decisions.after: But refuse to enroll younger widows, for when their desires draw them away from Christ, they want to marry
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But refuse younger widows, for when their desires draw them away from Christ, they want to marry,

key_decisions.rationale: Renders faith as pledged commitment in this enrollment context.
key_decisions.before: and so incur judgment because they have abandoned their earlier commitment.
key_decisions.after: and incur judgment because they have set aside their first commitment.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: thus incurring judgment because they have set aside their former pledge.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the escalating gendered critique and house-to-house movement.
key_decisions.before: At the same time they learn to be idle, going from house to house—and not only idle but gossips and busybodies, saying things they should not.
key_decisions.after: At the same time, they learn to be idle, going from house to house; and not merely idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things they should not.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: At the same time they learn to be idle, going about from house to house, and not only idle but also gossips and busybodies, saying what they should not.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the speaker's specific desire, three household roles and public rationale.
key_decisions.before: Therefore I want younger widows to marry, have children, manage a household, and give the opponent no opportunity for slander.
key_decisions.after: So I want younger women to marry, bear children, manage their households and give the opponent no opportunity for slander.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So I desire that younger widows marry, bear children, manage their households, and give the adversary no opportunity for slander.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the feminine subject of the pinned reading and allocation of support.
key_decisions.before: If any believing woman has widows in her family, let her help them so the church is not burdened and can help those who are truly widows.
key_decisions.after: If any believing woman has widows in her family, let her help them, so that the church is not burdened and can help those who are truly widows.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If any believing woman has widows, let her care for them; let the church not be burdened, so that it may care for those who are truly widows.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves leadership, doubled honor and teaching labor.
key_decisions.before: Let elders who lead well be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in word and teaching.
key_decisions.after: Let elders who lead well be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in speaking and teaching.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let the elders who rule well be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in preaching and teaching.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps public correction and its deterrent purpose.
key_decisions.before: Those who persist in sin, rebuke in front of everyone so that the rest may have fear.
key_decisions.after: Rebuke those who persist in sin before everyone, so that the rest may also have fear.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Those who persist in sin, rebuke in the presence of all, so that the rest may stand in fear.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps caution in appointment, complicity and personal integrity.
key_decisions.before: Do not lay hands on anyone hastily or share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
key_decisions.after: Do not lay hands on anyone hastily or share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, nor share in the sins of others; keep yourself pure.
